name: Millennia Cashback
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions between ₹400 and ₹5,000
diningBenefits: Up to 20% off at partner restaurants via the dining programme
onlineShoppingBenefits: 5% cashback on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Swiggy and Zomato
eligibility: Salaried or self-employed, age 21-60, credit score 750+
benefits: ₹1,000 fee waived on annual spends above ₹1,00,000
description: An everyday cashback card built for people who do most of their spending online. The flat 5% rate on major marketplaces and food delivery apps makes it one of the simplest cards to extract value from without tracking reward point conversions.

name: SBI Cashback Card
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹100 per statement cycle
onlineShoppingBenefits: Flat 5% cashback on all online spends with no merchant restrictions
benefits: Flat 5% cashback on every online merchant
Automatic cashback credit to the statement
Annual fee reversed on spends above ₹2,00,000
description: The most straightforward cashback proposition in the demo set. There is no merchant list to memorise: every online transaction earns 5%, capped monthly. Best suited to heavy online spenders who dislike reward point redemption.

name: Atlas
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹400 per cycle
diningBenefits: Up to 25% off through the Axis dining delights programme
onlineShoppingBenefits: 2 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on general online spends
eligibility: Salaried or self-employed, age 18-70, strong credit history
benefits: 10 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on airline and hotel bookings
Transfer miles to 20+ airline and hotel partners
Milestone bonus of 5,000 miles on ₹7,50,000 annual spend
description: A travel-first card for people who fly regularly enough to make transferable miles worth the annual fee. The accrual on direct travel bookings is the strongest in this set, and the lounge allowance covers international terminals.

name: Regalia Gold
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹500 per cycle
diningBenefits: Complimentary Swiggy One and membership dining discounts
onlineShoppingBenefits: 5X reward points on Nykaa, Myntra, Marks & Spencer and Reliance Digital
description: A balanced premium card that spreads its value across travel, dining and shopping rather than concentrating it in one category. A reasonable first premium card for someone who travels a few times a year but is not a frequent flyer.

name: Membership Rewards
diningBenefits: Amex dining offers at selected premium restaurants
onlineShoppingBenefits: 1,000 bonus points on 4 transactions of ₹1,500 each every month
eligibility: Age 18+, Indian resident, credit score 750+, no payment defaults
benefits: 18-24% effective value on Taj and Flipkart vouchers
description: A points-accumulation card where the value comes from disciplined milestone hitting rather than headline rates. Redemption into hotel and voucher partners gives the strongest returns; cash redemption is deliberately weak.

name: Amazon Pay Card
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver at all fuel stations
diningBenefits: Up to 15% off through the ICICI culinary treats programme
onlineShoppingBenefits: 5% back for Prime members and 3% for non-Prime on Amazon
eligibility: Age 18+, existing or new ICICI customer
benefits: Lifetime free with no annual or joining fee
5% back on Amazon for Prime members
description: The best zero-cost entry point in the set. Because there is no annual fee there is no spend threshold to justify, which makes it a sensible first card or a permanent secondary card for Amazon-heavy households.

name: FIRST Select
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹300 per cycle
onlineShoppingBenefits: 10X reward points on incremental spends above ₹20,000 per month
benefits: Lifetime free with no annual fee
description: Unusual in offering lounge access and a 10X accelerator without charging an annual fee. The accelerator only applies to incremental spend above a monthly threshold, so the real return depends on consistent monthly volume.

name: BPCL Octane
fuelBenefits: 7.25% value back on BPCL fuel spends including surcharge waiver
diningBenefits: 10X reward points on dining and departmental store spends
onlineShoppingBenefits: 10X reward points on selected online categories
benefits: 25 reward points per ₹100 at BPCL outlets
description: A single-purpose card that makes sense only for people with a substantial monthly fuel bill. At roughly 7% value back on fuel it repays its annual fee quickly for daily commuters, and is poor value for anyone else.

name: Live+ Card
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹250 per cycle
diningBenefits: 10% accelerated cashback on all dining and food delivery
onlineShoppingBenefits: 10% cashback on grocery and supermarket spends
eligibility: Salaried, age 18-65, resident in a serviceable city
benefits: 10% cashback on dining, food delivery and groceries
Annual fee waived on spends above ₹2,00,000
description: Targets the everyday-household category that most cashback cards ignore. Groceries and food delivery at 10% is a high rate, but a monthly cap on accelerated cashback keeps the realistic return closer to the base rate for big spenders.

name: ACE
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹500 per cycle
diningBenefits: Up to 20% off at partner restaurants
onlineShoppingBenefits: 4% cashback on Swiggy, Zomato and Ola
benefits: 5% cashback on bill payments through Google Pay
4% cashback on Swiggy, Zomato and Ola
Annual fee waived on spends above ₹2,00,000
description: A low-fee card whose distinctive feature is 5% back on utility and bill payments, a category almost every household has and most cards exclude. The 2% base rate is also above average for this fee bracket.
